title: MAIN EVENT v2
look: Real live pay-per-view MMA broadcast footage, not a commercial: bright even overhead TV lighting, a white octagon canvas, black padded posts, black chain-link cage fence, a dark packed arena beyond with phone lights in the crowd. Broadcast-camera image with natural motion blur and slight lens breathing.

august.name: AUGUST

refs.what: one large yellow sponsor wordmark printed flat across the center of his jersey chest, the only print on the jersey

august.description: a lean athletic blond fighter with a very short buzzcut and pale blue eyes; wearing a fitted black short-sleeve fight jersey with a subtle dark grey geometric pattern and a thin yellow trim, black fight shorts with a yellow waistband, plain black fingerless MMA gloves; calm, focused, economical in every movement

adgar.name: ADGAR

refs.what: one large white sponsor logo (a shield mark above a lowercase word) printed flat across the center of his jersey chest, the only print on the jersey

adgar.description: a giant super-heavyweight with a thick dark beard, massive shoulders and a heavy frame; wearing a fitted dark red and black short-sleeve fight jersey with an angular camouflage pattern, black fight shorts with a dark red waistband, plain black fingerless MMA gloves; intimidating, aggressive, sure of himself

announcer.name: THE ANNOUNCER
announcer.description: a charismatic ring announcer with slicked back silver hair in a black tuxedo with a black bow tie, holding a silver handheld microphone

referee.name: THE REFEREE
referee.description: a bald referee in a plain black short-sleeve shirt and black trousers, wearing thin black latex gloves

caster_a.name: THE PLAY-BY-PLAY COMMENTATOR
caster_a.description: a middle-aged commentator in a dark suit with a broadcast headset microphone

caster_b.name: THE COLOR COMMENTATOR
caster_b.description: a retired fighter turned commentator with a shaved head and a tight black polo shirt, wearing a broadcast headset microphone
